name: Apify MCP Server
summary: Hosted and open-source MCP server that lets agents run thousands of Apify Store Actors (scrapers, crawlers, automations) for social media, search, maps, e-commerce and any website.
description: Connect to the hosted Streamable HTTP endpoint `https://mcp.apify.com` via OAuth or an `Authorization: Bearer <APIFY_TOKEN>` header (the legacy `/sse` endpoint has been removed), or run locally over stdio from npm (`@apify/actors-mcp-server`). Agentic payments without an Apify token: buy a prepaid token from AGI (agi.apify.com) with x402 or MPP, pay per request via direct x402 (USDC on Base, Pay Per Event Actors only), or use Skyfire. Apify plans: Free ($0 with $5/month to spend), then Starter $19, Scale $199 and Business $999 per month plus pay-as-you-go; Actors carry their own pricing.

agent_access.notes: OAuth or Bearer APIFY_TOKEN; unauthenticated requests get 401. Token-less paid runs via AGI (x402/MPP), direct x402 or Skyfire.
